The Roles & Responsibilities of the Treasurer's Office.
The treasurer is responsible for the receipt, management, disbursement, financial reporting, and investment of all monies paid to the county and serves as an agent for the State of Iowa Department of Transportation and Iowa Department of Revenue. The county treasurer is elected every four years at a general election.
The treasurer is responsible for the proper receipt, accounting, and disbursement of county funds within the policies established by the State of Iowa, Ringgold County Board of Supervisors, and corporate and unincorporated taxing entities for adequate financial control.
Duties
Motor vehicle titling and registration, and driver's license issuance
Collecting Use Tax
Preparing and mailing annual tax statements for property tax collections
Tax apportionment to all taxing bodies and investment of county funds
Balancing financial records
Receipting all funds coming into the county from the various departments
